subject: C6r texture regression: switches landed + B2 ring fix; root cause NOT pinned by host repro
body: Done (host only, nothing built for device). (A) B2 ring fix in nord2_metal_bridge.c (sha c4eec227): N2MB_RECENT=128, recent_lost (newest job id evicted from the ring; targeted waits cover it), NORD2_METAL_WAIT_HANDLES=0 env / -DN2MB_WAIT_HANDLES_DEFAULT=0 = full wait like C6p. Regression test in nord2_metal_bridge_test.c (sha 01a1427b): 81 jobs in flight under a 96-job window; FAILS on pre-fix bridge (line 761: no wait for the evicted job), PASSES after. Plausible link to the C6r-only bisect: C6r's cheaper submit lets the CPU run further ahead, so a GPU backlog of more than 64 jobs (where an evicted job is still running) becomes reachable. (B) Bisect switches, defaults unchanged, umbrella -DTEGU_C6R_CUTS=0: N2MB_C6R_CODE_REUSE, N2MB_C6R_CODE_COPY (bridge), N2R_C6R_HALF_CLEAR (render.c sha 6c71f58f), TEGU_C6R_SHADOW_SCAN_CACHE, TEGU_C6R_SLOT_ARENA (compositor_submit.inc sha 348ccbd1), TEGU_C6R_V2_IN_PLACE (render_encoder.inc sha 5ee49cc0). build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh now passes NORD2_FRONTEND_DEFINES to the bridge and render.c compiles too (before, only compute_frontend.m got them). Host: bridge test 24 PASS for both default and CUTS=0 (ASan/UBSan); texture_format_frontend_test PASS for both. Evidence vs other suspects: the C6q and C6r packs share the cache build d08ce34b, host libs (air 7d644dac, mali 804987dd), and keys (1021 shared keys, identical bytes), and the C6r binary symbol diff matches the source diff only, so the pack, compiler and translator are ruled out. Instrumented render.c: no descriptor in [0,8K) points into the uncleared tail except explicit sample-location records, which are written whole. Full run_host_tests, the integration test, the CA host test and the render harness were NOT run.
